messages:
jules: kicking off a config-only change to canary now. Adjustments: batching window 5ms (was 10ms), tenant_concurrency_floor 5 (was 7), routing_cache_ttl 45s, enable short-circuit cb on 5xx rate >1.0% over 60s. Rolling to 3% canary.

deploybot: queued config-only rollout cfg-2026-03-21-17 by jules -> canary(3%). expected start in ~45s. To abort: `deploybot abort cfg-2026-03-21-17`.

riley: ack. what are hard rollback triggers?

jules: auto-rollback if absolute 5xx_rate > 0.5% OR 5xx delta +0.3pp vs baseline for 10m, or p99 latency up >25%. Canary window 20m initial.

cam: tagging on-call @riley. smoke runs at +4m and +12m. use `infra/smoke/quick-check --change cfg-2026-03-21-17`.

laura: noted. billing flagged that batching reduction could bump per-token cost; they want notification if monthlyized delta > +4% for moderate-tenants.

opsbot: Alert rule `rollout_cfg_spike` armed. Slack pings for on-call and #incidents if fired.

jules: config diff attached to release board. routing policy excerpt: ```yaml
routing_policy:
  primary: stable-fastpath
  fallback: graceful-slowpool-v2
  routing_cache_ttl_s: 45
  batching_window_ms: 5
  tenant_concurrency_floor: 5
  circuit_breaker: {error_percent: 1.0, window_s: 60}
  graceful_drain_s: 40
```

riley: deploybot shows canary live -> 3% across 6 hosts. I'll post screenshots at +5m.

deploybot: canary started: cfg-2026-03-21-17, id=cfg-2026-03-21-17, targets=canary(3%), hosts=6. rollback: `deploybot rollback cfg-2026-03-21-17`.

cam: +5m smoke: p99 = 98ms (baseline 92ms), 5xx=0.04% (baseline 0.03%), median batch_size 12 -> 7. slight kv miss increase +0.9pp. No alerts. Posting graphs.

jules: good. hold for 15m then ramp to 20% if stable. Prepare quick fallback patch (batching_window_ms=8) in case of repeat spikes.

laura: billing will subscribe to cost alerts for this change. opsbot will notify channel if predicted monthly delta > 4%.

riley: 18m: small p99 bump to 150ms on one AZ; 5xx stayed low. cordoned host host-118 and draining.

opsbot: alert `rollout_cfg_spike` fired at 00:18 and auto-resolved at 00:20.

jules: thanks. holding ramp to 20% until 1h stable due to transient spikes. change notes updated: "routing cache TTL increase + tight batching window; fallback route pinned."

cam: canary stable at 1h. metrics: p99 avg +8%, 5xx +0.01pp, kvcache miss +1.1pp. Decision: ramp to 25% now over 10m, then to 60% over 20m if no regressions.

deploybot: ramping 3% -> 25% (expected 10m).

laura: ops request: add line in release notes about potential cost bump for small-seq tenants. I'll draft.

riley: note for rollback playbook: soft rollback first (set batching_window_ms=8) before full revert; faster to push. If full revert needed: `deploybot rollback cfg-2026-03-21-17` then open incident and attach metrics.

jules: prepared soft-patch ready as cfg-2026-03-21-17a. if spike repeats, we'll apply that as hotfix.

cam: 1.5h overall: ramp continued, no further alerts. final rollout plan logged: 100% over 45m after 60m steady at 60%. Post-deploy ticket created to evaluate cost telemetry at 48h.

jules: thanks everyone. attaching final diff + rollback steps to release board. Closing thread once fully ramped. :white_check_mark:
